title: The Mawdeep Sinkholes
changes: A new way down opens: the Sinkway, a cave on the beach south of Sunken Lake, west of the river mouth. Heroes of level 30 and above can climb down it.
Below lies the Mawdeep Sinkholes, the homeland of the Hide-Kin: mossy ground, overgrown pits, burrow mounds and cave mouths under loam cliffs.
The land is quiet for now: Ropewell, its monsters and quests are on the way.
